QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Urgent Mission Complete
QuestInfo.0: Deliver the Ancient Book to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: The book contains research notes on an ancient power. Whatever the Black Wings' plans might be, the power clearly shouldn't be in their hands. On a brighter note, the Empress has something to say to you...
QuestInfo.2: Mission technically accomplished, but the Resistance still distrusts the Cygnus Knights. The Empress sees a better future for both groups, and reminds you that the Knights aren't alone.
